description: A bilingual (Simplified Chinese / English) annex to an equipment supply contract between an invented medical centre and an invented supplier, written as a Word document with python-docx: numbered clauses with the Chinese text followed by the English text, and a 40-row price table with a repeating header row that runs over three pages; its No. column is a Word numbered list. The Chinese font SimSun is not installed and LibreOffice substitutes WenQuanYi Zen Hei; Arial becomes Liberation Sans. The PDFs were rendered by LibreOffice 24.2 from the Office files (headless --convert-to pdf), not by Microsoft Office. Edits: the delivery period changed in both languages; the warranty retention changed in the Chinese text only (the English text still says 10%, an inconsistency a reviewer should catch); a mini centrifuge row inserted after row 5; the unit price of the real-time PCR system lowered, which also changes its amount; the ultrasonic cleaner row deleted; and as a result the table total and the total in Chinese capital numerals (大写) changed. Consequences that are not listed: the automatic row numbers from row 6 on, row 36 (cell counter) moving from page 2 to page 3, and the header row repeated at the top of pages 2 and 3.

truth.note: Chinese text of clause 3.3 only; the English sentence below still says 10%.
New table row (MC-7, 10 × 1,350.00 = 13,500.00); every cell of the row is new.
Amount of QP-480 (2 × unit price), in the same row as the unit price; it changes because the price changed, but it is a printed figure a reviewer must check.
